fee_details:
- Joining fee: Rs.5000
- Annual fee: Rs.5000
joining_perks: Welcome Bonus: when you activate the Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card, you can receive up to 5000 Edge Miles as a welcome gift. The exact amount depends on the card variant you choose; the bonus is credited after making your first transaction with the card.
reward_structure:
Edge Miles Reward Program: The Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card rewards you Edge Miles as reward points on purchases. These miles can be redeemed for air miles with partnered airlines, hotel stays, or even as statement credit, making the card highly rewarding for frequent travellers.
Domestic Purchases: Earn Edge Miles for every rupee spent on transactions within India.
International Transactions: Earn more Edge Miles when you spend abroad.
key_highlights:
- Welcome Bonus up to 5000 Edge Miles
- Edge Miles reward points on every transaction
- Airport Lounge access
- Travel Insurance
- Additional benefits like concierge services, driving discounts, and special offers at luxury hotels

benefits_features.Travel benefits: Earn Edge Miles for every rupee spent on travel bookings done through the Axis Bank travel portal.  Redeem Edge Miles for air miles with partnered airlines, hotel stays, or even as statement credit.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Fuel transaction surcharge: 1% of transaction amount(indicated for fuel transactions between Rs.500 and Rs.5,000 Per Statement Cycle).
benefits_features.Dining benefits: You can get up to 20% discounts when you dine with partner restaurants.
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: Airport Lounge Access: When you book flights by going through the Axis Bank Atlas travel portal, enjoy complimentary access to airport lounges in both domestic and international airports, ensuring a more comfortable travel experience.  Silver Tier: Complimentary visits per year to domestic and international airport lounges. Gold Tier: 6 complimentary visits annually to international lounges, allowing you to relax before your flights with enhanced comfort.  Platinum Tier: 12 complimentary visits per year, providing access to luxurious lounges at airports until departure.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: The Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card offers different tiers based on the total amount spent annually within a year: Silver, Gold, and Platinum. Each tier comes with its own set of perks that enhance the overall value, particularly for frequent travellers.
benefits_features.Insurance benefits: Complementary Travel Insurance: Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card bestows travel insurance at no additional cost, offering protection against unforeseen events. Air Accident Cover: Provides financial coverage in case of travel-related death or disability. Lost Baggage Insurance: Protects against the financial impact of lost luggage, giving you peace of mind on your trips.

how_tos.Redeeming Edge Miles: Edge Miles can be redeemed for air miles with partnered airlines, hotel stays, or even as statement credit.
how_tos.Availing Airport Lounge Access: Book flights through the Axis Bank Atlas travel portal to avail complimentary access to airport lounges.
how_tos.Filing Travel Insurance Claims: Details not provided in the given context

reward_point_benefits:
- Domestic Purchases: Earn Edge Miles for every rupee spent on transactions within India.
- International Transactions: Earn more Edge Miles when you spend abroad.
- Miscellaneous Benefits: Upon meeting this year’s minimum spend of Rs. 2,00,000 in Edge Miles as a cashback, it can be redeemed for travel statement credit.

fees_and_charges.Cash advance fee: 2.5%, Min Rs.500 of the Cash Amount
fees_and_charges.Late payment:
- Upto Rs.500: NIL
- Rs.501 to Rs.5000: Rs.250
- Rs.5001 to Rs.10000: Rs.750
- More than Rs.10000: Rs.1200
fees_and_charges.Cheques dishonour or returned auto-debit: 2% of the payment amount subject to min Rs.450 and max Rs.1,500
fees_and_charges.Fuel transaction Surcharge: 1% of transaction amount(indicated for fuel transactions between Rs.500 and Rs.5,000 Per Statement Cycle)

miscellaneous: Additional Benefits: On top of the travel perks, you also enjoy exclusive privileges like concierge services, driving discounts, and special offers at luxury hotels, making this card ideal for frequent business or leisure travellers.

faqs.Is there any fuel surcharge waiver with: Yes, a surcharge benefit of 1% of the transaction amount. This is reduced for transactions between Rs.500 and Rs.5,000 per statement cycle.
faqs.What welcome bonus do I get with the cre: You get a welcome gift of up to 5000 reward points when you complete your first transactions with the Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card.
faqs.Do I get any dining benefits with the cr: Yes, you can get up to 20% discounts when you dine with partner restaurants.
faqs.What are the limits of the credit card f: The over limit fee is 2.5% of the over limit amount (Min Rs.500).
faqs.Will I get a Platinum Tier Membership?: Yes, you get a Platinum Tier Membership when you spend over Rs.5 Lakhs in a year.
faqs.What are the major updates or changes on: The Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card updated its offers effective 20th April 2024, excluding categories like gold/jewellery and removing from existing EDGE Miles. There’s now a cap on accumulated EDGE Miles for travel transactions, with up to 100,000 miles available per annual spending thresholds. Additionally, fee-based Airport Meet & Assist services and complimentary concierge service have been discontinued.
